note: No hosts. A withdrawal binds only the hosts that hold it; one delivered nowhere withdraws nothing, while reading to the caller as though it had.
No signing key. The recipient signs as the room with a key named explicitly; one looked up from the room would be a mapping nothing maintains.
A caller-chosen revokedAt. The recipient stamps the time it signs; a caller who dated a withdrawal could reach back past a re-admission, or forward past grants not yet made.
A subject that is not a DID. Credentials name their subject by DID; a name matches no credential and would withdraw nobody while looking as though it had.
The same host twice. Each host is delivered to once and reported once.
